A little surprise for my favourite human ❤️

Happy Birthday,
Suru ❤️

To the girl who somehow manages to be my best friend, biggest headache, safest place… and a little more special than I usually admit. 😉

Dear Suru… 💌

Some people enter our life and become a memory. Some become a friend. And then there are those rare people who quietly become a feeling. You are that rare person for me. You get angry over the smallest things, you can go from laughing to almost crying in seconds, you have your wonderfully weird moments, and honestly… sometimes I have absolutely no idea how to handle you. 😂 But somehow, even after all the arguments, teasing, misunderstandings and your legendary “I'm not talking to you!” moments… I always end up wanting to talk to you again. Because your presence has become a part of my everyday happiness. You're not just the friend I can joke with. You're the person I can be completely myself around. The person whose smile can change my mood. The person I worry about even when I pretend I don't. And maybe… somewhere between all those conversations, fights, laughs and little moments, you became a little more important to me than a “best friend” is supposed to be. ❤️ I won't make this too obvious though… Because then you'll get that cute angry face, overthink everything, and probably say, “काय रे वेड्या?!” 😂❤️ So today, I'll simply say this: Happy Birthday, Suru. May you always have reasons to smile, people who genuinely care for you, dreams that come true, and a life full of the happiness you deserve. And whenever life gets a little difficult, remember that somewhere there is one stupid person who will always be ready to irritate you, make you laugh, listen to your nonsense, fight with you… and still stay. ❤️ Maybe that's what makes you so special to me. Happy Birthday, my favourite troublemaker. 🎂❤️

Our Little Memory Wall 📸

Two photos, countless memories… and hopefully many more to come. ❤️

There is one more thing… 👀

You've reached the part where I stop pretending this is just a normal birthday wish.

Suru…

If friendship had a “favourite person” category,
you'd probably have won it a long time ago. ❤️

And if there is something more hidden between the lines…
well… maybe you'll have to figure that one out yourself. 😉

Until then, keep smiling. Your smile is one of my favourite things.
